title: PathwayReferenceRanges
description: Curated reference ranges, schema 1: web/public/data/pathway-reference-ranges.json. The ranges Hormonal Pathways shows for a marker when the reading carries no lab-printed range, each figure recorded exactly as a cited source printed it, in the unit it printed it in; the app converts for display through its unit helpers and never stores a converted figure or a factor. App-internal data with no outside authors, so the objects are CLOSED, as in analytes-1.schema.json.

loinc.description: A LOINC code in its printed form, as in analytes-1.schema.json.

loincs.description: Required. Catalog codes whose readings these ranges apply to, any unit variant included.

molarMass.description: Optional. The molar-masses.json entry a mass↔molar display conversion derives its factor from.

range.title: Range
range.description: One population's interval as a source printed it. Several rows may share a population when the source printed the same interval in more than one unit.

unit.description: Required. The unit the source printed the figures in, Latin spelling.

sources.description: Required. Ids into `sources`, in citation order.

retrieved.description: Required. ISO date the quoted text was retrieved from `url`.

quote.description: Required. The source's own words carrying the figures.
